title: Bandwidth-Tunable Quantum Light Source at 1.5 $μ$m
summary: Quantum light sources constitute a crucial physical resource for the construction of quantum networks. Despite remarkable recent progress, there remains a lack of systematic investigation into the bandwidth tunability of quantum light sources under fixed waveguide parameters. In this work, we demonstrate a broadband quantum light source in the 1.5 $μ$m band with tunable bandwidth by changing the temperature of a piece of periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide.
